source: NOAA ETOPO 2022 v1 15 arc-second surface elevation
sourceVerticalReference: EGM2008 height where encoded by EPSG:9518; retained as source metadata and not assumed equal to canonical DEM vertical datum
role: derived broad seabed basis over a buffer around the full Wenzhou display domain; not a historical sounding survey or sea-surface datum
displayBoundaryPolicy: source mosaic is buffered beyond the active terrain window; runtime clips only with the final historical land/water mask, never with this rectangular source boundary
truthBoundary: ETOPO supplies broad derived relief only. Historical map controls coastline/islands. Dynamic sea surface remains separate. Uncertain shoreline cells are not rendered.
